spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace ownership is backend-enforced. A deal summary is not a complete report; read each deal and its required revision before drawing conclusions.

description: List a bounded page of collection deals in the selected seller workspace. Follow nextCursor to enumerate the full set, then read a deal for its latest or historical revision and source command.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass unchanged to continue; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum deals on this page, 1 to 50. Omit for the default of 20.

name: spellbook_collection_buying_list
